top_signals.title: Strait of Hormuz Shipping Marks Slight Rise

top_signals.title: Bond Markets Calling Bessent's 'Bluff': QI Research CEO
top_signals.summary: QI Research CEO & Chief Strategist Danielle DiMartino Booth tells Bloomberg TV that long-term Treasury stability requires confronting US debt and deficit concerns. She adds that Scott Bessent's buyback program risks continuous pushback from bond traders threatening to call the Treasury's 'bluff.' (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva said he will not protect his son from corruption allegations, insisting he’s innocent but pledging that he’ll have to face the consequences if any wrongdoing is proven.
